        id: pages-repeat-saved-pair
        if: inputs.fresh_after_cancelled_replay == true && steps.preflight.outputs.should_run == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          RAVRADAR_PAGES_REPEAT_ANCHOR: ${{ inputs.repeat_anchor }}
          RAVRADAR_PAGES_REPEAT_ACTION: ${{ steps.operational-action.outputs.action }}
          SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_URL }}
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${{ inputs.completed_private_runtime }}" = false
          test "${{ steps.private-runtime-install.outcome }}" = success
          test "${{ steps.exact-weather-recovery.outputs.required }}" != true
          test "${{ steps.historical-wave-predecessor.outputs.required }}" != true
          test "${{ steps.paired-checkpoint-route.outputs.required }}" != true
          node scripts/pages-cancelled-replay-continuity.mjs admit
